title: Let's Learn English Lesson 29
subtitle: A Long Time Ago
attribution: Source: VOA Learning English – Let's Learn English Level 1, Lesson 29: A Long Time Ago (learningenglish.voanews.com). Public domain. This unofficial study helper is not affiliated with VOA.

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hello! In Washington, D.C., there are many places that bring history to life. But people who live here often do not have time to see them. They are too busy with work -- like me. Hi, Marsha!
dialogue.zh: 嗨！在華盛頓特區，有很多地方能讓歷史活起來。可住在這兒的人常常沒時間去看。他們工作太忙——比如我。嗨，瑪莎！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Hi, Anna! Have a seat.
dialogue.zh: 嗨，安娜！坐吧。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Thanks. This was a good idea. Working outdoors is nice.
dialogue.zh: 謝謝。這主意不錯。在戶外工作真好。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Um-hum, it is.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，是的。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I am tired. Today was a busy day at work. And I still have work to do!
dialogue.zh: 我累了。今天上班很忙。我還有工作要做！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Hmm, that's too bad.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，真可惜。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: How are you these days?
dialogue.zh: 你最近怎麼樣？

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: I'm really busy too, Anna. Let's get to work.
dialogue.zh: 我也很忙，安娜。我們開始幹活吧。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Marsha, look! That bus has a photo of Abraham Lincoln!
dialogue.zh: 瑪莎，看！那輛公交車有亞伯拉罕·林肯的照片！

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: That's an advertisement for Ford's Theatre. They have a new show.
dialogue.zh: 那是福特劇院的廣告。他們有一場新演出。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: They have shows where Abraham Lincoln died?
dialogue.zh: 他們在亞伯拉罕·林肯去世的地方演戲？

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Yeah, it's a working theater and a museum.
dialogue.zh: 對，它既是還在演出的劇院，也是博物館。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: I love Lincoln. You know, Marsha, that advertisement reminds me of something.
dialogue.zh: 我喜歡林肯。你知道嗎，瑪莎，那個廣告讓我想起一件事。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Um-hum. What's that?
dialogue.zh: 嗯。是什麼？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: When I was a little girl … When I was a little girl … I was not like other children.
dialogue.zh: 我小時候……我小時候……我不像別的孩子。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Um-hum, I can believe that.
dialogue.zh: 嗯，我能相信。

dialogue.speaker: Anna's voice
dialogue.en: I was a tall, serious child. At the playground the other children played silly games. They played with dart guns. They played on the swings, the slide and the teeter-totter. They also played ball. But not me. I loved to read serious books about U.S. presidents.
dialogue.zh: 我是個又高又嚴肅的孩子。在操場上，別的孩子玩傻遊戲。他們玩玩具槍。他們玩鞦韆、滑梯和蹺蹺板。他們也打球。可我不。我喜歡讀關於美國總統的嚴肅書。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: In fact, I wanted to be … don't laugh … President of the United States.
dialogue.zh: 其實，我想當……別笑……美國總統。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: (laughs)

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Stop! I know it's a silly childhood dream.
dialogue.zh: 別笑！我知道這是個傻傻的童年夢想。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: I'm sorry. It's not silly. Guess what I wanted to be?
dialogue.zh: 對不起。這不傻。猜猜我想當什麼？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: What?
dialogue.zh: 什麼？

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: I wanted to be... an astronaut.
dialogue.zh: 我想當……宇航員。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Really?
dialogue.zh: 真的？

dialogue.speaker: Marsha's voice
dialogue.en: When I was a kid, I studied the stars and planets. I wanted to fly into outer space!
dialogue.zh: 我小時候研究星星和行星。我想飛到外太空！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: You know, Marsha, childhood dreams are really important.
dialogue.zh: 你知道嗎，瑪莎，童年夢想真的很重要。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: They are. And it's good to remember them.
dialogue.zh: 是的。而且記得它們很好。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Hey! I have an idea. Let's go.
dialogue.zh: 嘿！我有個主意。走吧。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Go where?
dialogue.zh: 去哪裡？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Let's go make our childhood dreams come true.
dialogue.zh: 我們去讓童年夢想成真。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: We're going to the Air & Space Museum! Yes!
dialogue.zh: 我們要去航空航天博物館！太好了！

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: No. We're going to see a show at Ford's Theatre just like Abraham Lincoln did when he died! It's not far from here.
dialogue.zh: 不。我們要去福特劇院看演出，就像亞伯拉罕·林肯去世那天那樣！離這兒不遠。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Uh huh. That is your childhood dream.
dialogue.zh: 嗯哼。那是你的童年夢想。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Good point. Okay, next week, we'll come here and be astronauts.
dialogue.zh: 說得對。好，下週我們來這兒當宇航員。

dialogue.speaker: Marsha
dialogue.en: Honestly?
dialogue.zh: 真的？

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Honestly.
dialogue.zh: 真的。

dialogue.speaker: Anna
dialogue.en: Tonight we are seeing a show at Ford's Theatre, where a man shot President Abraham Lincoln. This is history come to life … and a childhood dream come true! Until next time ...
dialogue.zh: 今晚我們在福特劇院看演出，就是有人開槍打死亞伯拉罕·林肯總統的地方。這是活過來的歷史……也是童年夢想成真！下次見……

choices: To be President of the United States

quiz.prompt: What did Marsha want to be?
